notes: Strip f: x 7680-10480 plus ~300 px west overlap (from 7380). Plate is turned: Montgomery Road is the top edge, Dana Avenue runs NNW-SSE from Montgomery to Duck Creek Road; the railroad / CITY LIMIT runs along the NE side east of Dana (no streets between Dana and the tracks except Floral). Centrelines were fitted from cross profiles of the printed street lines; Dana's centre was taken midway between its block lines (the pipe lines in Dana are near its centre). Names printed: DANA, RUTLAND AVE., BEVIS AVE., WABASH (no suffix), EVANSTON (no suffix seen), CHARLTON AVE., OESPER ... AVE., PETER (no suffix), FLORAL AVE., DUCK CREEK ROAD (ROAD on the road, DUCK / CREEK along the creek), LAKE (no suffix), LILAC AVE., HOLLY AVE., IVY AVE., POTOMAC AVE., VISTA AVE., GRIGG A., BRADLEY AVE., CLAYLAND ST. Inferred, not printed in the strip: Trimble Avenue (only AVE. printed here; TRIMBLE is printed far west on the same line, x~4100), Clarion Avenue (the N-S street west of Dana: continuation of CLARION AVE north of Trimble, jogging at Trimble), Montgomery Road. Assumed suffixes: Wabash, Evanston, Peter, Lake -> Avenue. Two unnamed 30-ft streets: (1) Bradley's L-continuation to Potomac on Grigg's line, (2) the street north of Lake crossing Duck Creek. Not picked (outside the overlap): Clarion/Trimble jog (x~6900), Clarion/Bevis (x~7230), Rutland north of x 7380, a stub labelled PARK... leaving Vista at x~7330,y~5940, Section Avenue / Evanston junction at x~6900,y~3270. East of the railroad (outside the city limit) two short street stubs show at x~9480,y~2690 and x~9840,y~3140 (the latter meeting a strip along the tracks' east side); not picked because no named street meets them on the plate. Subdivision labels (LYON'S EST., J.S. LOWRY'S SUB, CROWLEY'S SUB, SUBDIV'N 1, etc.) are not streets.
